OnlineDegree.com historical courses

Retired for new courses. Provider confirms its free courses stopped January 29, 2025; prior students can request transcript assistance.

Historical resource · do not treat as a current enrollment offer

How the credit works

Historical NCCRS-recommended learning only; completion date and destination evaluation still matter.

Pace and learning format

No new course-completion route; historical record retrieval only.

Costs to check

Do not budget historical low-cost exam offers as currently available. Confirm any historical transcript-request requirements with support.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Previously completed coursework requires official historical evidence; there is no current examination offer to schedule.

Before you commit

  • Identify the exact course or examination, completion date, and original transcript source.
  • Ask your receiving school how it evaluates this historical learning.
  • Do not assume an old recommendation or agreement remains available for new study.
